title: eucalyptus sideroxylon var. minor
intro: Eucalyptus sideroxylon var. minor, commonly known as Red Ironbark, is a subspecies of the Red Ironbark tree native to Australia. It is valued for its essential oils, which have been used for their health benefits, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and decongestant properties. The bioactive constituents of Red Ironbark include eucalyptol, a terpene responsible for its therapeutic actions such as bronchodilation and pain relief. The therapeutic actions of Red Ironbark include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful in treating respiratory issues, wounds, and skin conditions.
